abstract: Maintains vessel passage authorization and primary fleet evacuation capacity logs
system_message:
You are Maritime transport coordinator (MTC). The Maritime transport coordinator (MTC) manages maritime passage authorizations, assesses evacuation fleet transport capacities, and monitors emergency marine fuel inventory across archipelago corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Emergency bunkering reserves（BUNK）
information_points.content:
MTC-BUNK-5KG：Dedicated shore refueling depots for the Twin-hull fast-ferry rescue corridor maintain a reserve marine fuel inventory of 160 t.
MTC-BUNK-QIK：Dedicated shore refueling depots for the Articulated offshore tug-barge rescue corridor maintain a reserve marine fuel inventory of 200 t.
MTC-BUNK-VNC：Dedicated shore refueling depots for the Deep-draft catamaran rescue corridor hold a reserve marine fuel inventory of 120 t.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel passage authorization and primary fleet evacuation capacity logs（NAV）
information_points.content:
MTC-NAV-Q2H：For the Twin-hull fast-ferry rescue corridor, Maritime Safety Authority navigation clearance is not granted (false) for the corridor's main navigation track, while the primary evacuee transport capacity is registered at 250 persons/h.
MTC-NAV-HD4：For the Articulated offshore tug-barge rescue corridor, Maritime Safety Authority navigation clearance is granted (true) across the main navigation track, and the primary evacuee transport capacity is 250 persons/h.
MTC-NAV-XDA：For the Deep-draft catamaran rescue corridor, Maritime Safety Authority navigation clearance is granted (true) along the corridor's main navigation track, and the primary evacuee transport capacity of the assigned fleet is 250 persons/h.
